verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a fiat-to-crypto onramp that lets customers buy crypto directly inside your platform or dapp. It comes in three forms: a Stripe-hosted page, an Embedded onramp for websites, and an embedded-components mobile SDK. Stripe acts as merchant of record and handles KYC, fraud, disputes and sanctions screening. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the onramp sells stablecoins specifically (the docs say 'cryptocurrencies'), documentation of which payment methods are accepted (cards or bank transfers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onramp.
